atoms.b: Subordinating conjunctions are linking words that combine an independent clause with ((++a_dependent an_independent)) clause.

instruction.text: Is this an independent clause or a dependent clause?

end.text: The first part “If you want to go hiking...” cannot stand alone. So, it’s a dependent clause.
The second part “... you should wear appropriate shoes.” can stand alone. It’s an independent clause.
